the study of medium modifications of vector meson properties in the nuclear matter.
the study of the in-medium properties of vector mesons, which are important for the understanding of the hot and dense medium produced in heavy-ion collisions and the study of the QCD phase diagram.
the construction and study of a consistent and complete model for the pion- and photon-nucleon interaction in the low energy region.

our scheme provides the most consistent description of the experimental πN and γN data available so far.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the s-wave ω-meson nucleonscattering amplitude has a large imaginary part at low ω-meson energies.
the ρ-meson is strongly suppressed at low energies in nuclear matter, whereas the ω-meson is only moderately affected by the medium.
